name: Moonlight, Memories, and Ashes
source:
Dara, plagued by nightmares of his childhood sweetheart, returns to Dublin after a long absence to discover what happened to the man he loved the most.

[From [url=https://burnedoutgames.itch.io/moonlight-memory-and-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达拉被关于儿时恋人的噩梦纠缠，阔别多年后回到都柏林，试图查明自己最深爱的那个男人，究竟发生了什么。

[摘自[url=https://burnedoutgames.itch.io/moonlight-memory-and-ashes]itch.io[/url]]
